#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""TASK-20260924-624abf (J5) blind re-derivation: Q1 and Q2 from primary sources.

Zero experiment runs; no curve is instantiated and no point arithmetic is done.
Everything below is integer arithmetic and arithmetic in F_2[t]/(f) on the
printed curve COEFFICIENTS only.

Independent implementations are used for each load-bearing computation:
  * primality: own trial division (small n) / sympy.isprime (BPSW) / python-flint fmpz.is_prime (FLINT proof)
  * ord_n(2): own maximal-proper-divisor reduction / brute-force loop / sympy.n_order
  * subfield membership: own carry-less GF(2)[t] arithmetic / python-flint fq_default field
"""
import json, re, sys, math, hashlib, platform
from functools import reduce

import sympy
import flint
import pymupdf
import pypdf

SCR = "/tmp/claude-0/-home-user/7e7e6610-8884-5732-bf35-bb48340cf7d3/scratchpad/624abf"
REPO = "/home/user/crypto-autoresearcher"

LOG = []
def log(*a):
    s = " ".join(str(x) for x in a)
    LOG.append(s)
    print(s)

def sha256(path):
    h = hashlib.sha256()
    with open(path, "rb") as f:
        h.update(f.read())
    return h.hexdigest()

log("python", platform.python_version(), "sympy", sympy.__version__,
    "python-flint", flint.__version__, "FLINT", getattr(flint, "__FLINT_VERSION__", "?"),
    "PyMuPDF", pymupdf.VersionBind, "pypdf", pypdf.__version__)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 0. Source texts
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
NIST_PDF = f"{SCR}/NIST.FIPS.186-4.pdf"
X962_PDF = f"{SCR}/x962-11-17-97.pdf"
X962_OCR = f"{SCR}/x962-11-17-97_djvu.txt"
RFC3279 = f"{SCR}/rfc3279.txt"
REPO_FIPS_TXT = f"{REPO}/inputs/FIPS186-4-BINARY-CURVES/fips186-4_text.md"
REPO_BAILEY_TXT = f"{REPO}/inputs/BAILEY-2009-541-ECC2K130/paper_fulltext.md"
for p in [NIST_PDF, X962_PDF, X962_OCR, RFC3279, REPO_FIPS_TXT, REPO_BAILEY_TXT]:
    log("sha256", sha256(p), p)

def pdf_text_pymupdf(path, pages):
    d = pymupdf.open(path)
    return "\n".join(d[i].get_text("text") for i in pages)

def pdf_text_pypdf(path, pages):
    r = pypdf.PdfReader(path)
    return "\n".join(r.pages[i].extract_text() for i in pages)

# NIST FIPS 186-4: Appendix D.1.3 is on PDF pages 102-110 (1-based), D.4 on 116-118.
nist_idx = list(range(101, 110)) + list(range(115, 118))
nist_mu = pdf_text_pymupdf(NIST_PDF, nist_idx)
nist_pp = pdf_text_pypdf(NIST_PDF, nist_idx)
repo_fips = open(REPO_FIPS_TXT, encoding="utf-8").read()
# X9.62 working draft 1997-11-17: Appendix H.4 on PDF page indices 88..96.
x962_idx = list(range(88, 97))
x962_mu = pdf_text_pymupdf(X962_PDF, x962_idx)
x962_pp = pdf_text_pypdf(X962_PDF, x962_idx)
x962_ocr = open(X962_OCR, encoding="utf-8", errors="replace").read()
bailey = open(REPO_BAILEY_TXT, encoding="utf-8").read()

def squash(s):
    return re.sub(r"[\s\\]+", "", s)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Parse FIPS 186-4 D.1.3 Koblitz curves (from NIST PDF via PyMuPDF)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
def parse_fips_K(text, m):
    i = text.index(f"Curve K-{m}")
    j = text.index("Polynomial Basis", i)
    sec = text[i:j]
    a = re.search(r"a\s*=\s*\n?\s*([01])\s", sec).group(1)
    k = sec.index("n =")
    lines = sec[k + 3:].splitlines()
    frags = []
    for ln in lines:
        s = ln.strip()
        if not s:
            if frags:
                break  # a blank line ends the number (prevents swallowing a page number, e.g. '98')
            continue
        if re.fullmatch(r"\d+\\?", s):
            frags.append(s.rstrip("\\"))
        else:
            break
    return int(a), frags, sec

def parse_fips_poly(text, m):
    i = text.index(f"Degree {m} Binary Field")
    sec = text[i:i + 400]
    pm = re.search(r"p\(t\)\s*=\s*([^\n]+)", sec).group(1)
    T = re.search(r"T\s*=\s*\n?\s*(\d+)", sec).group(1)
    exps = []
    for term in pm.split("+"):
        term = term.strip()
        if re.fullmatch(r"t\s*(\d+)", term):
            exps.append(int(re.fullmatch(r"t\s*(\d+)", term).group(1)))
        elif term == "t":
            exps.append(1)
        elif term == "1":
            exps.append(0)
        else:
            raise ValueError(f"unparsed term {term!r} in {pm!r}")
    return exps, pm.strip(), int(T)

def parse_fips_V(text, m):
    i = text.index(f"Curve K-{m}:")
    sec = text[i:i + 600]
    mm = re.search(r"V\(" + str(m) + r"\)\s*=\s*([–\-]?)\s*((?:\d+\\?\s*)+)", sec)
    sign = -1 if mm.group(1) in ("–", "-") else 1
    return sign * int(re.sub(r"[^\d]", "", mm.group(2)))

KOBLITZ = {}
for m in [163, 233, 283, 409, 571]:
    a, frags, sec = parse_fips_K(nist_mu, m)
    n = int("".join(frags))
    assert n.bit_length() <= m, (m, n.bit_length())
    exps, pm, T = parse_fips_poly(nist_mu, m)
    V_fips = parse_fips_V(nist_mu, m)
    # cross-check 1: same fragments in pypdf extraction of the same PDF
    a2, frags2, _ = parse_fips_K(nist_pp, m)
    # cross-check 2: every fragment appears, in order, in the repo pdfminer text of section K-m
    ri = repo_fips.index(f"D.1.3.{[163,233,283,409,571].index(m)+1}.1  Curve K-{m}")
    rj = repo_fips.index("Polynomial Basis", ri)
    repo_sec = repo_fips[ri - 200:rj]
    pos, inorder = 0, True
    for fr in frags:
        q = repo_sec.find(fr, pos)
        if q < 0:
            inorder = False
            break
        pos = q + len(fr)
    KOBLITZ[m] = dict(a=a, n=n, n_frags=frags, poly_exps=exps, poly_text=pm, T=T, V_fips=V_fips,
                      pypdf_a=a2, pypdf_frags=frags2, pypdf_agrees=(a2 == a and frags2 == frags),
                      repo_pdfminer_fragments_in_order=inorder)
    log(f"FIPS K-{m}: a={a} n={n} ({n.bit_length()} bits) frags={frags} poly={pm} T={T} V(m)[D.4]={V_fips}")
    log(f"   pypdf agrees: {a2 == a and frags2 == frags}; repo pdfminer text contains same fragments in order: {inorder}")

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Parse ECC2K-130 from Bailey et al. 2009, Appendix A (repo derived text)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
i = bailey.index("Appendix A: Parameters of the ECC2K-130 challenge")
secA = bailey[i:i + 1200]
log("Bailey Appendix A raw:\n" + secA[:700])
ell = int(re.search(r"ℓ\s*=\s*(\d+)", secA).group(1))
bits_claim = int(re.search(r"(\d+)-bit prime", secA).group(1))
fpoly_txt = re.search(r"F\(z\)\s*=\s*([^\n]+?)\.", secA).group(1)
ECC2K = dict(m=131, a=0, b=1, ell=ell, bits_claimed=bits_claim, field_poly_text=fpoly_txt,
             curve_text="y2 + xy = x3 + 1 over F2131 (Appendix A: 'the Koblitz curve y2+xy = x3+1 over F2131'); |E| = 4*ell")
log(f"ECC2K-130: ell={ell} ({ell.bit_length()} bits; paper says {bits_claim}-bit) field poly text: {fpoly_txt}")

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Parse ANSI X9.62 working draft (1997-11-17) Appendix H.4 sample curves
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
HEXLINE = re.compile(r"^[0-9A-F]+( [0-9A-F]+)*$")
def grab_hex(sec, label):
    """Collect hex after 'label =' (inline and following hex-only lines)."""
    mm = re.search(r"(?m)^\s*" + re.escape(label) + r"\s*=\s*(.*)$", sec)
    if not mm:
        return None, []
    raw = []
    inline = mm.group(1).strip()
    if inline:
        if not HEXLINE.match(inline):
            return None, [inline]
        raw.append(inline)
    for ln in sec[mm.end():].splitlines()[1:]:
        s = ln.strip()
        if s == "":
            continue
        if HEXLINE.match(s):
            raw.append(s)
        else:
            break
    return "".join(raw).replace(" ", ""), raw

def x962_section(text, m):
    mm = re.search(r"Examples? With m = " + str(m) + r"\b", text)
    i = mm.start()
    j = text.index("H.4.", i + 10)
    return text[i:j]

X962 = {}
for m, label in [(176, "c2pnb176w1"), (208, "c2pnb208w1"), (272, "c2pnb272w1"),
                 (304, "c2pnb304w1"), (368, "c2pnb368w1"), (163, "c2pnb163v1-candidate(H.4.1 Example 1)")]:
    sec = x962_section(x962_mu, m)
    if m == 163:

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Arithmetic helpers
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
def trial_prime(n):
    if n < 2:
        return False
    d = 2
    while d * d <= n:
        if n % d == 0:
            return False
        d += 1
    return True

def trial_factor(n):
    f, d = {}, 2
    while d * d <= n:
        while n % d == 0:
            f[d] = f.get(d, 0) + 1
            n //= d
        d += 1
    if n > 1:
        f[n] = f.get(n, 0) + 1
    return f

def fmt_fact(f):
    return " * ".join(f"{p}^{e}" if e > 1 else f"{p}" for p, e in sorted(f.items()))

# GF(2)[t] arithmetic on Python ints (bit i <-> t^i)
def gf2_mulmod(x, y, f, m):
    r = 0
    while y:
        if y & 1:
            r ^= x
        y >>= 1
        x <<= 1
        if (x >> m) & 1:
            x ^= f
    return r

def gf2_sq(x, f, m):
    return gf2_mulmod(x, x, f, m)

def gf2_orbit_len(x, f, m):
    """Least d >= 1 with x^(2^d) = x (degree of x's minimal polynomial over F_2)."""
    y = x
    for d in range(1, m + 1):
        y = gf2_sq(y, f, m)
        if y == x:
            return d
    raise RuntimeError("no return within m squarings: f not irreducible?")

def gf2_trace(x, f, m):
    t, y = 0, x
    for _ in range(m):
        t ^= y
        y = gf2_sq(y, f, m)
    assert t in (0, 1), t
    return t

def divisors(m):
    return [d for d in range(1, m + 1) if m % d == 0]

def gf2_in_subfield(x, d, f, m):
    y = x
    for _ in range(d):
        y = gf2_sq(y, f, m)
    return y == x

def flint_irreducible(f, m):
    """python-flint: factor f over F_2; irreducible iff a single factor of multiplicity 1 and degree m."""
    coeffs = [(f >> i) & 1 for i in range(m + 1)]
    P = flint.nmod_poly(coeffs, 2)
    lead, facs = P.factor()
    return (len(facs) == 1 and facs[0][1] == 1 and facs[0][0].degree() == m), P

def gf2_polymod(a, f):
    df = f.bit_length() - 1
    while a and a.bit_length() - 1 >= df:
        a ^= f << (a.bit_length() - 1 - df)
    return a

def gf2_polygcd(a, b):
    while b:
        a, b = b, gf2_polymod(a, b)
    return a

def own_rabin_irreducible(f, m):
    """Rabin's test: f of degree m is irreducible over F_2 iff t^(2^m) = t mod f and
    gcd(t^(2^(m/p)) - t, f) = 1 for every prime p | m."""
    def t_pow_2pow(j):
        y = 2  # the polynomial t
        for _ in range(j):
            y = gf2_mulmod(y, y, f, m)
        return y
    if t_pow_2pow(m) != 2:
        return False
    for p in sympy.primefactors(m):
        g = gf2_polygcd(f, t_pow_2pow(m // p) ^ 2)
        if g != 1:
            return False
    return True

def flint_orbit_len(x, f, m):
    coeffs = [(f >> i) & 1 for i in range(m + 1)]
    ctx = flint.fq_default_ctx(modulus=flint.fmpz_mod_poly_ctx(2)(coeffs), var="t", fq_type="FQ_NMOD")
    assert ctx.degree() == m
    X = ctx([(x >> i) & 1 for i in range(m)])
    Y = X
    for d in range(1, m + 1):
        Y = Y ** 2
        if Y == X:
            return d
    raise RuntimeError

def lucas_V(t, q, k):
    V0, V1 = 2, t
    if k == 0:
        return V0
    for _ in range(k - 1):
        V0, V1 = V1, t * V1 - q * V0
    return V1

def fips_V(mu, m):
    # FIPS 186-4 D.4 definition: V(0)=2, V(1)=mu, V(m)=mu*V(m-1)-2V(m-2)
    return lucas_V(mu, 2, m)

def is_prime_all(r):
    s = sympy.isprime(r)
    fl = flint.fmpz(r).is_prime()
    return bool(s), bool(fl)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Q1: multiplicative order of 2 modulo n
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
Q1 = []
for n in [131, 163, 233, 283, 409, 571]:
    prime_td = trial_prime(n)
    prime_sy, prime_fl = is_prime_all(n)
    cand = n - 1  # for prime n, the group (Z/nZ)^* has order n-1
    fac = trial_factor(cand)
    assert fac == sympy.factorint(cand)
    # evaluate 2^(cand/p) for each prime p | cand (maximal proper divisors of the candidate)
    at_cand = {f"2^({cand}/{p}) = 2^{cand//p} mod {n}": pow(2, cand // p, n) for p in sorted(fac)}
    # reduction to the exact order
    e = cand
    steps = []
    for p in sorted(fac):
        while e % p == 0 and pow(2, e // p, n) == 1:
            steps.append(f"2^{e//p} = 1 mod {n}, so e | {e//p}")
            e //= p
    fe = trial_factor(e)
    at_e = {f"2^({e}/{p}) = 2^{e//p} mod {n}": pow(2, e // p, n) for p in sorted(fe)}
    check_e = pow(2, e, n)
    # independent: brute force and sympy
    bf = next(k for k in range(1, n) if pow(2, k, n) == 1)
    sy = sympy.n_order(2, n)
    assert e == bf == sy, (n, e, bf, sy)
    rec = dict(n=n, is_prime=dict(trial_division=prime_td, sympy_isprime=prime_sy, flint_is_prime=prime_fl),
               n_minus_1=cand, factorisation_n_minus_1=fmt_fact(fac),
               powers_at_maximal_proper_divisors_of_n_minus_1=at_cand,
               reduction_steps=steps, e=e, factorisation_e=fmt_fact(fe),
               check_2_pow_e_mod_n=check_e, powers_at_maximal_proper_divisors_of_e=at_e,
               e_equals_n_minus_1=(e == n - 1), index_of_2=(n - 1) // e,
               cross_checks=dict(brute_force_least_k=bf, sympy_n_order=sy))
    Q1.append(rec)
    log(f"Q1 n={n}: prime={prime_td}/{prime_sy}/{prime_fl}; n-1={fmt_fact(fac)}; at max proper divisors of n-1: {at_cand}; steps={steps}; e={e}; 2^e mod n={check_e}; brute={bf}; sympy={sy}")

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Q2: k | r - 1 at eleven rows
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
def poly_from_exps(exps):
    return reduce(lambda acc, e: acc | (1 << e), exps, 0)

rows = []

def field_analysis(a, b, f, m):
    """Smallest subfields: of a, of b, of {1,a,b}; iso-class reading; flint cross-check."""
    irr_own = own_rabin_irreducible(f, m)
    irr_fl, _ = flint_irreducible(f, m)
    assert irr_own == irr_fl == True, (m, irr_own, irr_fl)
    da = 1 if a in (0, 1) else gf2_orbit_len(a, f, m)
    db = 1 if b in (0, 1) else gf2_orbit_len(b, f, m)
    da_fl = 1 if a in (0, 1) else flint_orbit_len(a, f, m)
    db_fl = 1 if b in (0, 1) else flint_orbit_len(b, f, m)
    assert (da, db) == (da_fl, db_fl), (da, db, da_fl, db_fl)
    d_lit = math.lcm(da, db)
    # membership table over all divisors (own implementation)
    table = {d: dict(a_in=gf2_in_subfield(a, d, f, m), b_in=gf2_in_subfield(b, d, f, m)) for d in divisors(m)}
    smallest_div = min(d for d, v in table.items() if v["a_in"] and v["b_in"])
    assert smallest_div == d_lit
    tr_a = gf2_trace(a, f, m)
    # F_{2^m}-isomorphism class: b fixed, a determined up to trace. Defined over F_{2^d} iff
    # b in F_{2^d} and (Tr(a) == 0 or m/d odd).
    d_iso = min(d for d in divisors(m) if table[d]["b_in"] and (tr_a == 0 or (m // d) % 2 == 1))
    return dict(field_poly_irreducible_flint=irr_fl, field_poly_irreducible_own_rabin=irr_own, deg_a=da, deg_b=db,
                deg_a_flint=da_fl, deg_b_flint=db_fl, d_literal=d_lit,
                d_field_of_moduli_F2_of_j=db, d_isomorphism_class_over_F2m=d_iso,
                trace_a=tr_a, subfield_membership_by_divisor=table)

def q2_row(label, source, m, a, b, f, r, h, h_basis):
    fa = field_analysis(a, b, f, m)
    d = fa["d_literal"]
    q = 2 ** d
    k = m // d
    s_prime, f_prime = is_prime_all(r)
    rem = (r - 1) % k
    verdict = "TRUE" if rem == 0 else "FALSE"
    # sensitivity to alternative readings of the field of definition / k (Q0)
    alt = {}
    for nm, dd in [("field_of_moduli_F2(j)", fa["d_field_of_moduli_F2_of_j"]),
                   ("F2m_isomorphism_class", fa["d_isomorphism_class_over_F2m"]),
                   ("k_equals_m_reading_(NOT the stated definition)", 1)]:
        kk = m // dd
        alt[nm] = dict(d=dd, k=kk, r_minus_1_mod_k=(r - 1) % kk, verdict="TRUE" if (r - 1) % kk == 0 else "FALSE")
    # integer-only transcription consistency checks (no curve instantiated)
    N = h * r
    hasse_ok = abs(2 ** m + 1 - N) <= 2 * math.isqrt(2 ** m) + 2
    return dict(row=label, source=source, m=m, r=r, r_bits=r.bit_length(), r_log2=round(math.log2(r), 6),
                r_is_prime=dict(sympy=s_prime, flint_proof=f_prime),
                field=fa, smallest_field_q=f"F_(2^{d})", q=q, k=k, r_minus_1_mod_k=rem, verdict=verdict,
                alternative_readings=alt, cofactor=h, cofactor_basis=h_basis, hxr=N, hasse_interval_ok=hasse_ok)

# 6a. X9.62 draft rows
x962_rows = [("c2pnb176v1", 176), ("c2pnb208w1", 208), ("c2pnb272w1", 272), ("c2pnb304w1", 304), ("c2pnb368w1", 368)]
for label, m in x962_rows:
    rec = X962[m]
    f = int(rec["f_hex"], 16); a = int(rec["a_hex"], 16); b = int(rec["b_hex"], 16)
    r = int(rec["n_hex"], 16); h = int(rec["h_hex"], 16)
    assert f.bit_length() - 1 == m, (m, f.bit_length())
    assert a.bit_length() <= m and b.bit_length() <= m
    exps = [i for i in range(m + 1) if (f >> i) & 1]
    row = q2_row(label, "X9.62 draft 1997-11-17 H.4", m, a, b, f, r, h, "printed h in draft H.4")
    row["field_poly_exponents"] = exps
    row["a_hex"], row["b_hex"], row["n_hex"], row["h_hex"], row["f_hex"] = rec["a_hex"], rec["b_hex"], rec["n_hex"], rec["h_hex"], rec["f_hex"]
    # Weil check with q = 2^d from coefficients and #E(F_q) := printed h (hypothesis)
    d = row["field"]["d_literal"]; q = 2 ** d; k = m // d
    t = q + 1 - h
    Nk = q ** k + 1 - lucas_V(t, q, k)
    row["weil_check"] = dict(hypothesis="printed h equals #E(F_q), q=2^d from coefficients",
                             q=q, t=t, hasse_over_Fq_ok=(t * t <= 4 * q), k=k,
                             Nqk=Nk, h_times_r=h * r, equal=(Nk == h * r))
    # also: does r divide #E(F_q)? (it cannot if equality holds and r > h)
    rows.append(row)

# 6b. ECC2K-130
m = 131
f131 = poly_from_exps([131, 13, 2, 1, 0])
row = q2_row("ECC2K-130", "Bailey et al. 2009 (IACR ePrint 2009/541) Appendix A", m, 0, 1, f131, ell, 4, "|E(F_2^131)| = 4*ell (Appendix A)")
row["field_poly_exponents"] = [131, 13, 2, 1, 0]
V = fips_V(-1, 131)  # a = 0 -> mu = (-1)^(1-a) = -1
row["koblitz_check"] = dict(mu=-1, V_m=V, Nm=2 ** 131 + 1 - V, four_ell=4 * ell, equal=(2 ** 131 + 1 - V == 4 * ell))
rows.append(row)

# 6c. FIPS K-curves
for m in [163, 233, 283, 409, 571]:
    K = KOBLITZ[m]
    f = poly_from_exps(K["poly_exps"])
    h = 2 if K["a"] == 1 else 4
    row = q2_row(f"K-{m}", "FIPS 186-4 Appendix D.1.3", m, K["a"], 1, f, K["n"], h,
                 "FIPS 186-4 D.1.3 preamble: h = 2 if a = 1, h = 4 if a = 0")
    row["field_poly_exponents"] = K["poly_exps"]
    row["a_coefficient"] = K["a"]
    mu = (-1) ** (1 - K["a"])
    V = fips_V(mu, m)
    row["koblitz_check"] = dict(mu=mu, V_m_computed=V, V_m_printed_FIPS_D4=K["V_fips"], V_matches_D4=(V == K["V_fips"]),
                                Nm=2 ** m + 1 - V, h_times_n=h * K["n"], equal=(2 ** m + 1 - V == h * K["n"]))
    rows.append(row)

# 6d. sensitivity: draft H.4.1 Example 1 (m=163) for the 'c2pnb163v1' reading of the row label
rec = X962[163]
f = int(rec["f_hex"], 16); a = int(rec["a_hex"], 16); b = int(rec["b_hex"], 16); r = int(rec["n_hex"], 16); h = int(rec["h_hex"], 16)
sens163 = q2_row("SENSITIVITY-ONLY draft H.4.1 Example 1 (m=163)", "X9.62 draft 1997-11-17 H.4.1", 163, a, b, f, r, h, "printed h")
sens163["weil_check"] = None

for rw in rows + [sens163]:
    fld = rw["field"]
    log(f"Q2 {rw['row']}: m={rw['m']} r={rw['r']} ({rw['r_bits']} bits) prime(sympy/flint)={rw['r_is_prime']} "
        f"irreducible f={fld['field_poly_irreducible_flint']} deg(a)={fld['deg_a']} deg(b)={fld['deg_b']} "
        f"d_literal={fld['d_literal']} d_j={fld['d_field_of_moduli_F2_of_j']} d_iso={fld['d_isomorphism_class_over_F2m']} Tr(a)={fld['trace_a']} "
        f"q=2^{fld['d_literal']} k={rw['k']} (r-1) mod k={rw['r_minus_1_mod_k']} verdict={rw['verdict']} hasse_ok={rw['hasse_interval_ok']}")
    if rw.get("weil_check"):

    if rw.get("koblitz_check"):
        log(f"    koblitz_check: {rw['koblitz_check']}")
    log(f"    alternatives: {rw['alternative_readings']}")

# 7. Null-object control: same test on the primes adjacent to r (same size, no Frobenius structure)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
NULL = []
for rw in rows:
    r, k = rw["r"], rw["k"]
    lo, hi = sympy.prevprime(r), sympy.nextprime(r)
    ent = dict(row=rw["row"], k=k, prevprime_r=lo, prevprime_minus_1_mod_k=(lo - 1) % k,
               nextprime_r=hi, nextprime_minus_1_mod_k=(hi - 1) % k,
               heuristic_probability_true_per_prime=(f"1/{k-1}" if k > 2 else "1"))
    NULL.append(ent)
    log(f"NULL {rw['row']}: k={k} (prevprime(r)-1) mod k={(lo-1)%k} (nextprime(r)-1) mod k={(hi-1)%k}")
n_true_null = sum((e["prevprime_minus_1_mod_k"] == 0) + (e["nextprime_minus_1_mod_k"] == 0) for e in NULL)
log(f"NULL summary: {n_true_null} of {2*len(NULL)} adjacent primes satisfy k | r'-1")

out = dict(Q1=Q1, Q2=rows, null_control=NULL, sensitivity_c2pnb163v1_reading=sens163, KOBLITZ_PARSE=KOBLITZ, X962_PARSE=X962, ECC2K130_PARSE=ECC2K)

    if isinstance(o, int) and not isinstance(o, bool) and abs(o) > 2 ** 53:

    s = f"mod {n}: at the maximal proper divisors of n-1 = {q['factorisation_n_minus_1']}: {a}."
    if q["reduction_steps"]:
        s += " Reduction: " + "; ".join(q["reduction_steps"]) + "."
    s += f" Final: 2^{e} = {q['check_2_pow_e_mod_n']}; at the maximal proper divisors of e = {q['factorisation_e']}: {b} (none equals 1), so e = {e}."
